# CORRECTING and REPLACING Ascent Industries Sets Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call for November 4, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET


October 26, 2026 10:41am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_cc3d89b4eacb2d4f999206e62bbdaca3/ascentco/news/2026-10-26_CORRECTING_and_REPLACING_Ascent_Industries_Sets_282.pdf)


SCHAUMBURG, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- The conference call date should read: Wednesday, November 4 (instead of Tuesday, November 4).


The updated release reads:


**ASCENT INDUSTRIES SETS THIRD QUARTER 2026 EARNINGS CONFERENCE CALL FOR NOVEMBER 4, 2026, AT 5:00 P.M. ET**


Ascent Industries Co. (Nasdaq: ACNT) (“Ascent” or the “Company”), a specialty chemicals platform focused on the development, production, and distribution of tailored, performance-driven chemical solutions, will hold a conference call on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Eastern time to discuss its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The results will be reported in a press release prior to the conference call.


Ascent management will host the conference call, followed by a question-and-answer period.


Date: Wednesday, November 4, 2026
Time: 5:00 p.m. Eastern time
Webcast Registration Link:[Here](https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/5ex4fikg)
Dial-in Link:[Here](https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BI0678095ffe754dc187c54f5ab66370cf)


To access the call by phone, please register via the live call registration link above and you will be provided with dial-in instructions and details. If you have any difficulty connecting with the conference call, please contact Investor Relations at 1-630-884-9181.


The conference call will also be broadcast live and available for replay via the webcast registration link above or[here](https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/5ex4fikg) . The webcast will be archived for one year in the investor relations section of the Company’s website at[www.ascentco.com](http://www.ascentco.com/) .


**About Ascent Industries Co.**


Ascent Industries Co. (Nasdaq: ACNT) is a specialty chemicals platform focused on the development, production, and distribution of tailored, performance-driven chemical solutions. For more information about Ascent, please visit its website at[www.ascentco.com](http://www.ascentco.com/) .
